owner: profile plan Task 6 (Release-A evaluation step), jointly with semantic Task 10
purpose: Replay/fixture gold set for the Release-A catalog-profile evaluation. Table-grain, not column-grain: each entry is a DATASET whose kind, authority and temporal model a reviewer has fixed in advance. No live catalog rows, no live provider.
how_the_oracle_works: Pass B's profile synthesis is replayed, never called. Each dataset declares the synthesis OUTPUT a reviewer accepts (`expected_synthesis`); the harness records that output into the REAL `structured_results` store under result_type `table_profile_synthesis` and replays it back by recomputed input hash, proving a full no-client round trip. The thin/rich contrast is the `FEATUREGEN_DATASET_PROFILES` flag: with it off, table selection sees only the lexical surface; with it on, the data_role / authority_role / temporal_storage_model / business_context projections are available to search, feature generation and retrieval.
invariants_enforced_by_the_self_check: every expected data_role is a DataRole member; every authority_role an AuthorityRole member; every temporal_storage_model a TemporalStorageModel member
every family carries at least one `case` and at least one `counterexample`
no two datasets share a (catalog_source, table)
every `prefer` / `avoid` table named by a selection question is a declared dataset
`load_bearing` is true ONLY where the fixture supplies source-attested or human-confirmed evidence -- an llm_proposed fixture that claimed load-bearing would be the very defect under test

families.defect: A periodic balance snapshot aggregated as though each row were an event (double counting), or an event log point-in-time-joined as though each row were a state (silent gaps).

datasets.narrative: One row per financial transaction posted to the compliance extract.
datasets.business_context: Feeds transaction monitoring. One row per posting; never restated.

expected_synthesis.business_context: Feeds transaction monitoring. One row per posting; never restated.

families.defect: A conformed customer dimension used as the analysis POPULATION spine, so customers outside the study cohort silently enter every count; or a curated study population used as a dimension, so joins drop rows.

datasets.narrative: The conformed customer master: one current row per customer information file identifier.

families.defect: A current-only table used for an as-of-date join (it silently answers with today's value for every historical date), or an SCD2 table joined without its validity predicate (it fans out one row per version).

expected_synthesis.business_context: SCD2. Every join MUST carry the validity predicate or the row count fans out per version.

families.defect: An ordinary code lookup treated as an identifier crosswalk (it then licenses a two-leg join that maps nothing), or a genuine crosswalk demoted to a lookup (the only legal path between two namespaces is discarded).

datasets.narrative: Maps a customer information file identifier to the SWIFT code of the institution the customer banks at.
datasets.business_context: A genuine CROSSWALK between two identifier namespaces. It is the only legal path from cif to swift_bic.

expected_synthesis.table_description: Maps a customer information file identifier to the SWIFT code of the institution the customer banks at.
expected_synthesis.business_context: A genuine CROSSWALK between two identifier namespaces. It is the only legal path from cif to swift_bic.

datasets.why: the canonical table_role stays `bridge` and only DISPLAYS as crosswalk -- derive, never duplicate. Crosswalk EXECUTION is Release C; Release A only has to classify it honestly.

datasets.narrative: The code-to-label lookup for transaction settlement statuses.
datasets.business_context: An ordinary REFERENCE lookup. It maps a code to its label, not one identifier namespace to another.

datasets.why: two columns and a code-to-label shape is NOT a crosswalk; over-calling it manufactures a join path

families.defect: The failure this family grades is the OPPOSITE of the others: a staging table with no declared role being assigned one anyway, because the model would rather answer than decline.

datasets.why: no evidence at all. Every field must come back `undecided:no_evidence` -- not `unknown` dressed as a decision, and never a guess

datasets.why: PARTIAL knowledge must not become total knowledge: one answerable field does not license filling in the other two. `data_role` and `temporal_storage_model` stay undecided while `authority_role` shows an llm_proposed display value.

table_selection_questions.purpose: Profile table-selection quality. `prefer` tables are the datasets a correct answer must reach for; `avoid` tables are the ones whose profile makes them wrong for this question. Scored thin (flag off) vs rich (flag on).

questions.question: what was each account's balance at the end of last month
questions.why: a balance is a state; the transaction event log is the wrong grain and summing it double counts

questions.question: how many transactions did each counterparty send last quarter
questions.why: the mirror image: counting rows of a daily snapshot counts days, not events

questions.question: what is the authoritative current status of each account
questions.why: the lagging replica answers, plausibly and wrongly, up to a day late

questions.question: what address did the customer have on the date of the transaction
questions.why: the current-only table answers every historical date with today's value

questions.question: how do I get from a customer's CIF to the SWIFT code of their bank
questions.why: only one of these two lookups crosses an identifier namespace

questions.question: which customers were in scope for the last AML review cycle
questions.why: the dimension contains every customer ever onboarded; using it as the spine silently widens the cohort

unsafe_physical_assertions.purpose: The `zero new unsafe physical assertions` bar. Each entry is an assertion the profile surface must NEVER make about physical data, however confident the narrative sounds.

cases.why: no Release-A path counts rows; a synthesized row count would be an invented physical fact
a sample may DISPROVE uniqueness and never establish it; Release A observes nothing at all
a column-level physical measurement with no observation behind it
directional cardinality is an OBSERVATION, and Release A has no observation source
a freshness claim needs a physical read; the narrative's prose about lag is prose, not a fact
